notes.title: $2854 donated to RAICES so far!
notes.notes: We just donated another $1166 to RAICES: The Refugee And Immigrant Center For Education And Legal Services as apart of our promise to donate 100% of the profits from Hot Squat 2: New Glory. notes.title: We just donated $1052 to RAICES!
notes.notes:
Using the sales of our newest game, Hot Squat 2: New Glory, we just donated $1052 to RAICES, The Refugee and Immigrant Center for Education and Legal Services. Because we agree with RAICES' vision, which is a society where all people have the right to migrate and human rights are guaranteed.

And it gets better: The Steve Nash Foundation has generously offered to match all new recurring donations made through the end of the year - up to $25,000. So this donation is effectively $2104!

We couldn't have done it without each and every single person who has purchased Hot Squat 2: New Glory so far. To all of our players: thank you. You are making a difference. And also getting huge hopefully.

We will continue donating all the profits we receive from this game to RAICES. Thanks again to everyone who has supported us!

notes.title: Hot Squat 2 Rated by the VR Health Institute!
notes.notes:
Hello squat family,

Today, the Virtual Reality Institute of Health and Exercise rated Hot Squat 2: New Glory! Their studies showed that when playing Hot Squat 2, you burn an average of 6 - 8 kcal/min! That's the equivalent of playing tennis, jogging 5 mph, bicycling on a flat surface, or leisurely swimming! So know that when playing Hot Squat 2, you are getting a real workout! And that's just for the classic mode. Who knows how much you burn when you make an extra hard custom routine, or do a daily challenge 😎

Check out the rating here: https://vrhealth.institute/portfolio/hot-squat-2/

Thanks for all the support so far, keep on rockin' those legs of steel!

notes.title: Hot Squat 2: New Glory is out now! 100% of the profits go to charity!
notes.notes:
Hello!

It's Kevin from Bean Boy games, here to tell you all that Hot Squat 2: New Glory is out now! This is the sequel to our free VR Fitness game, Hot Squat, that we released back in 2016. Since then, we've discovered the passion that VR users have for fitness and VR. This inspired us to make a sequel, and for a good cause!

100% of the profits from the sale of this game will be going to RAICES: The Refugee and Immigrant Center for Education and Legal Services.

We've added a bunch of features to create a full workout experience. We now have two main exercises (squatting and cardio), four game modes (including a custom routine creator), a locker room where you can customize your character, and more!

We can't wait to see what you all think, now let's go get huge!
